summary: Held the entire episode -- this SHORT entry was correct from the start and never came close to threatening the entry. It ran from 0 to a peak of about +200pts around t=21m, then chopped/consolidated in the +100 to +170pts range through t=32m, still deeply profitable at window close. Pullbacks (giveback 15-60% of the CURRENT LEG amplitude) repeatedly recovered to new highs or restabilized well above zero, and even the deepest local retracements never approached breakeven, so none qualified as wrong-direction. What I'd watch next time: distinguish leg-relative giveback (which can look large, e.g. 50-60%, on a small recent swing) from giveback relative to total realized profit -- the former spiked misleadingly a few times while the position was still hugely in the money. Multiple against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP) firing together preceded pullbacks but never preceded an actual reversal toward the entry price, so simultaneous against-fires alone were not sufficient grounds to bail here.
